The structure of Na2Cu6O6F8 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group Cm (No. 8), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over nine independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cu in tetrahedral environments coordinated by four F neighbors and Na in octahedral environments coordinated by six F neighbors. The Cu- and Na-centered polyhedra exhibit corner- and edge-sharing relations, while O-centered tetrahedra show corner and edge sharing, forming a three-dimensional geometric neighbor network.
